tasks.contract: Integrate graduated usage bands, per-account credit and integer-cent invoice lines with stable band boundaries.
Integrate minimal circular longitude bounds with point projection and viewport consumer across the antimeridian.
Integrate half-open room reservations and cleaning buffers into earliest common availability search.
Integrate Unicode code-point offsets, nonoverlapping search matches and bounded context snippets.
Integrate literal/parameter/wildcard route precedence and decoded captures with handler invocation.
Compose generated-to-intermediate and intermediate-to-source mapping anchors with unmapped segments and diagnostic consumers.
Integrate multipart body construction with inline content IDs, ordered attachment deduplication and safe headers.
Integrate fenced-block-aware heading scanning, repeated anchor slugs and hierarchical table of contents.
Integrate deterministic seeded user buckets, explicit targeting override and disabled-flag fallback.
Integrate injected monotonic clock, token refill and retry-after computation into request admission.
Integrate UTC weekly recurrence enumeration, exclusion dates and event-specific replacement occurrences.
Integrate dimensional weight rounding, per-zone tariffs and oversize rejection into parcel quote batches.
Integrate weighted ranked-choice elimination rounds, exhausted ballots and deterministic audit report.
Integrate ordered crop/rotate/resize geometry operations with metadata dimensions and no-op preservation.
Integrate event-time windows, late-event policy and watermark flushing with grouped metric summaries.
Integrate conditional required fields, nested validation paths and stable accessible error summaries.
Integrate role grants, explicit resource denies and wildcard scope matching into authorization explanation.
Integrate hook dependency order, value transformations and early stop semantics into plugin execution.
Integrate density/width srcset parsing, candidate selection and duplicate-descriptor errors.
Integrate tree traversal, hidden ancestors and current-node labels into accessible breadcrumb output.
Integrate valid traceparent parsing, baggage allowlisting and child-span header construction.
Integrate allowlisted nested field projection, renaming and absent/null distinctions in API response views.
Integrate byte-fragment reassembly, UTF-8 decoding and interleaved control frames into message consumer.
Integrate signed integer ledger entries, reversal references and per-currency settlement conservation.
Integrate day-count proration, plan-change boundaries and invoice adjustment line aggregation.
Implement isolated undo/redo history with branch truncation, capacity limits and no-op updates.
Implement integer interval insertion/removal, canonical adjacency merging and membership round-trip.
Implement causal vector comparison, pointwise merge and zero-counter normalization without input mutation.
Implement tagged add/remove operations and replica merge retaining concurrent additions.
Persist and resume bounded online reservoir sampling with deterministic PRNG state and batch equivalence.
Implement deterministic plain-JSON canonicalization with sorted object keys, preserved arrays and finite-number domain.
Implement length-prefixed binary field serialization with unknown byte-tag preservation and strict truncated-input errors.
Implement field-level three-way draft merge, deletion sentinels and conflict reporting relative to common base.
Implement sparse matrix coordinate encoding, zero elision and rectangular dimensions through save/load.
Implement persistent prefix dictionary updates, deletion and sorted prefix queries with snapshot isolation.
Implement append-only checkpoint replay with verified checksum chain and explicit corrupt-tail rejection.
Implement permitted state transitions, duplicate event-id handling and deterministic replay consistency.
Implement recency-order export/import with capacity eviction and side-effect-free inspection.
Implement query parameter multimap edit/serialize preserving duplicate value order and explicit empty values.
Implement timestamp/offset record normalization preserving instant and signed offset without host timezone dependence.
Implement run-length bitmap encoding/decoding, empty dimensions and invalid-run rejection.
Persist probabilistic membership bits with fixed hash policy and compatible union preserving no-false-negative behavior.
Implement hierarchical checkbox state propagation, indeterminate ancestors and snapshot restore.
Implement text line-start index updates across insert/delete boundaries and CRLF normalization rules.
Implement sortable rational position keys and deterministic rebalancing preserving item order.
Implement chunk store manifests, deduplication and reference-count-safe deletion.
Implement idle plus absolute session expiry, touch semantics and serialized clock-independent state.
Implement atomic plain-JSON path operation lists with array index validation and rollback on invalid operation.
Implement priority/deferred item transitions and stable export/import without losing insertion sequence.
Implement line-based patch application with context matching, conflict rejection and inverse restoration.
Support sync and async iterables through one consumer with early-return cleanup and source error identity.
Add AbortSignal to a callback-only reader preserving callback-once behavior and existing call signatures.
Support repeated case-insensitive HTTP headers through legacy object and iterable input forms.
Add quoted/escaped word tokenization to a legacy whitespace splitter under explicit literal grammar without command execution.
Add options-object overload to a range formatter while retaining positional arguments and default rules.
Bridge sync/async resource disposal while preserving nested LIFO cleanup and original body errors.
Extend binary-search API with comparator/key-extractor overloads and explicit first/last duplicate insertion bounds.
Preserve base-path resolution and query/fragment behavior when adding URL-object input to existing string API.
Add cancellable delay promises with injected timers and listener cleanup without changing existing delay callers.
Accept ArrayBuffer and typed-array subviews in a checksum consumer without including unrelated backing bytes.
Extend strict date parser to ISO week dates while retaining calendar-date validation and no timezone rollover.
Introduce read-only Map-like views preserving iteration and live-source updates while denying mutator escape.
Add Promise finally support to a minimal thenable adapter preserving fulfillment/rejection and finalizer errors.
Extend media-type consumer to quoted parameter values and escaped separators while retaining token-only parsing.
Accept RegExp filters without leaking lastIndex across entries or mutating caller-owned patterns.
Add explicit BigInt wire representation to a JSON API without confusing ordinary lookalike objects.
Expose cause chains in error presentation while preserving legacy messages and handling cycles safely.
Add lazy default factories to settings lookup preserving explicit undefined/null and call-count contracts.
Extend shallow copy adapter to enumerable symbol properties preserving getters and descriptor-independent values.
Accept bounded array-like collections in a batching consumer while retaining holes and index order semantics.
Add timing instrumentation wrappers preserving this, arguments, return identity and thrown errors.
Add ASCII-insensitive aliases while preserving exact command precedence, help ordering and collision refusal.
Support LF/CRLF streamed text chunks preserving split delimiter boundaries and final unterminated lines.
Add tagged optional results to a consumer while preserving legacy direct values and explicit failure tags.
Extend a sorting consumer to custom comparators while preserving ties, sparse input policy and input immutability.
Separate expression lexing from evaluation while preserving precedence, token spans and exact syntax failures.
Extract deterministic state reducer from an effectful counter controller and preserve effect order via returned actions.
Replace ambient time reads with injected clock in reminder selection while preserving inclusive due boundaries.
Separate chunk formation from upload transport preserving byte order, chunk bounds and first-failure behavior.
Replace scattered status classifications with one reusable classifier preserving known and unknown status behavior.
Remove repeated normalization across a validation pipeline while preserving public outputs and explicit normalization call counts.
Split configuration tokenization/parsing while preserving exact line/column error locations and accepted grammar.
Refactor in-place board move logic into pure transitions with legacy mutating wrapper behavior preserved.
Replace recursive materialized traversal with lazy generator preserving preorder, pruning and early-termination behavior.
Replace recursive flattening with stack-based traversal preserving depth limits, ordering and sparse-array rules.
Separate percent-encoding policy from query rendering preserving UTF-8 escapes and reserved-character behavior.
Unify duplicated integer-ratio rounding across billing helpers preserving negative tie policy and totals.
Extract ID allocation dependency from record creation preserving uniqueness checks and no allocation on validation failure.
Refactor fail-fast validation into reusable collection helper with legacy fail-fast wrapper and new all-errors API.
Separate manifest path filtering from filesystem adapter preserving ordering, excluded paths and no unnecessary reads.
Extract host-independent POSIX path normalization from CLI handling preserving root clamping and trailing slash contracts.
Refactor expression rendering to a visitor interface preserving minimal parentheses and literal escaping.
Separate color parsing, transformation and output formatting preserving clamping, rounding and alpha behavior.
Extract reusable AND/OR validation combinators preserving short-circuiting, error order and old schema outcomes.
Replace array accumulation with incremental fold preserving empty input, numeric bounds and stable aggregate results.
Separate row/column layout strategies from a grid renderer preserving spans and occupied-cell conflict behavior.
Refactor channel switches into injected handlers preserving fallback, message order and unknown-channel behavior.
Extract traversal from log redaction preserving nested arrays, cycles, key policy and non-mutation.
Inject random-number source into shuffle preserving permutation, bounds validation and legacy entry point.
Refactor direct conversions into reusable conversion graph preserving supported values and rejecting inconsistent paths.
